content: Hoga Keketina Hi Nosolaan
Yaka Yehoba i baek Mosese elana i ba,
“Nu ba Isileli elal, nihi nopil nihi na nihi holaviya Pi Hahilot labenaa, Migadol ge Hoga Keketina ali nuwanuwanaa. Nihi holaviya hoga bebenaa, ge Bal Sepon ni minek hoga labi etega al.
Yaka kin ni nuwatu ni ba, ‘Isileli nuwaliya i gewagewa ge hi nonobwagabwaga ya. Nige wali abanok, kaiwena ula kekevana i kausil.’
Atena na pagasisi inoke ni tatauliulil-agimiu, yaa alonau wana tolohaveyan na lakel ge wasau ni lelu. Yaka Itipita nihi atena te nau Yehoba.” Inoke Isileli hi ginol ola to.

Sauga Itipita wali kin i hago gamagalau iyaka hi egonan, inoke alonau ana tolabe wali nuwatu hi pil ge hi ba, “I bwe ta ginol ola! Isileli iyaka ta talamwagil hi egon, yaka nige al nihi tutuwalali kaiwela!”
Inoke kin wana waga momomol ge wana tolohaveyan i lovivina-agil.
Waga momomol bolo waiwaisal ali gewi sikis handeled (600) ge Itipita ana waga momomol gegewel al, ginebi ali tomatahikan, i ahel alonau.
Yehoba kin atena i pagasisi, inoke kin i tatauliulil Isileli eliyaa, heliya aloliya wali atimatuwa hi nawanawa.

Itipita ana tolohaveyan, ginebi wali hosi ge waga momomol gegewel ge ali tomatahikan, Isileli hi tataulilil-agil. Inoke hi kukuhikagil wali abaholaviya Hoga Keketina bebenaa Pi Hahilot labenaa, ge Bal Sepon i minek hoga labi etega al.
Sauga Isileli hi kite kin alonau wana tolohaveyan iyaka hi nopakelakelaubwa hi nenem eliyaa, inoke hi lovakun ge labe kaiwena hi yoga ha Yehoba elana.
Yaka hi baek Mosese elana hi ba, “Ga i ola! Age nige salai i gagana Itipita ge u ahema ha nem ula kekevana elana naha yaomal? I bwe ge matama u pwamwa ha tagilem Itipita?
Iyaka ha pwawa i ola valila ha ba haba elam Itipita, ha ba, ‘U telema ya naha tuwalali Itipita elal.’ Binimala naha tuwalali kaiweliya, inoke nige naha yayaomal ula kekevana elana.”
Yaka analiya Mosese i lahe i ba, “Bahi lovakun! Ku milil gagasisi, inoke nuku kite Yehoba hauna ni ginol ge ni pwamwalimiu lan ebe. Itipita bolo ya ku kita pwamwatomwal, nige al nuku kikitel.
Yehoba iya ni lohaveyan kaiwemiu, yaa komiu nuku mibabakuhu ya.”
Yaka Yehoba i baek Mosese elana i ba, “Ga i ola ge labe kaiwena ku yoga eliyau? U ba Isileli nihi nawa nok awoliyaa.
Wam suki u latahin ge u paeluek hogaa, inoke ni maleli ge Isileli nihi nosola nuwanuwanaa datu pwatanaa.
Itipita ateliya na pagasisi, inoke nihi tatauliulil emiwa, yaka abwe kin alonau wana tolohaveyan, wana waga momomol ge ali tomatahikan, na lakel ge wasau ni lelu.
Na lakel inoke nihi atena te nau Yehoba.”
Yaka Yabowaine wana anelose, iya i miminaa boda Isileli awoliyaa, i sikal i na eliyaa. I ola al yaluyalu i milil i ola kokola i sikal i na eliyaa,
i miminaa boda Itipita ge boda Isileli ali hawawala. Inoke bulin bwabwaligena yaluyalu Itipita i pagogouil, yaa Isileli i pwamwananalil, yaka bulin o nige bosowailiya nihi petupatupa-agil.
Mosese nimana i paeluek hogaa, inoke bulin bwabwaligena Yehoba babaliman gasigasisena i patowa hoga i yu pamaleli ge nuwanuwana i dato.
Inoke Isileli hi nosola datu pwatanaa, hoga i talmilil i ola baba labena awoliyaa ge gegebaliyaa.
Yaka Itipita avaliyau wali hosi ge waga momomol gegewel ge ali tomatahikan, hi tatauliulil Isileli eliyaa hi na hi ulutuk hogaa.
Kelaubwa lan ni gan, Yehoba i minaa yaluyalu ge ginaha hi milil i ola kokola elana inoke matana i lilowana Itipita eliyalil ge nuwaliya i pagewagewa.
Yaka wali waga momomol ali wil i patalsup ge ali momomol i pulowan. Yaka Itipita hi ba, “Ta egonan! Yehoba Isileli i label ge i lohaveyan elala.”
Yaka Yehoba i baek Mosese elana i ba, “Nimwam u paeluek hogaa, inoke hoga ni bini sikal Itipita avaliyau wali waga momomol ge ali tomatahikan ni yabomwil.”
Yaka lan i gan Mosese nimana i paeluek hogaa, inoke hoga i bini sikal abanaa. Itipita nuwaliya nihi lou, yaa Yehoba i aliyohiliek hogaa.
Hoga i sikal, inoke Itipita ana tolohaveyan ginebi wali waga momomol ge ali tomatahikan, bolo hi tatauliulil hi ulutuk hogaa, gegewel i yabomwil, nige etega i mwamwal.
He Isileli hi nosola datu pwatanaa, hoga i talmilil i ola baba labena awoliyaa ge gegebaliyaa.
Inoke lan o Yehoba Isileli i pwamwalil Itipita nimaliyaa, ge Isileli Itipita bwaliwawagal
hi kitel gilesaa.
Sauga Isileli Yehoba wana gasisi bwabwatana hi kite Itipita i pakokovel, inoke hi lovakunan, yaka hi melteli iya ge wana totuwalali Mosese elal.

footnotes.text: Bwaliwagawaga ana sapu te gamagal toto iyaka i aliga tuwana.
